text:
emily_h: FYI — ClearWave (acct CW-112) flagged invoice INV-2026-03 showing both reserved commit and burst charges that overlap. Looks like the reserved commit was split, but the allocation tags were duplicated to prod and staging, so they got billed twice for the same commit window. Posting the relevant lines below.

emily_h: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-03 | CW-112 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $12,000.00
INV-2026-03 | CW-112-proj-staging | Burst (03/12 02:00-02:40) | $820.00
INV-2026-03 | CW-112-proj-prod | Reserved Commit (alloc 60%) | $7,200.00
INV-2026-03 | CW-112-proj-staging | Reserved Commit (alloc 40%) | $4,800.00  <-- this line is the duplicate
```

emily_h: They reached out asking for a breakdown and a credit for the duplicate reserved line. Need quick triage and a recommended credit amount before I respond.

samir_ops: Looking into metering/alloc service now. Ran `billingctl query --acct CW-112 --period 2026-03 --by-tag`. Output shows commit pool attached to both tags because of race in tag propagation during a rollout on 2026-03-12.

samir_ops: `billingctl` output (trimmed):
```
2026-03-12T01:58Z commit_assigned: pool=reserved-CW-112 tags=[cw:prod, cw:staging] amount=100%
2026-03-12T02:00Z failover:event -> staging receives traffic; kv-propagator retried, ended up duplicating tag set
```

samir_ops: TL;DR: commit usage was recorded once but the tag set included both prod+staging for that window so the allocator emitted two allocation lines. Metering shows the actual tokens consumed match the single commit; billing table split produced duplicate line.

janet_am: Thanks. Customer is asking for both an SLA credit (failover-caused latency spike) and correction for the duplicate reserved charge. Can you give a suggested credit number (provisional) so I can send to the customer? They want the corrected invoice and an ETA.

samir_ops: For the duplicate reserved commit line: that's exactly $4,800 (the 40% reserved line). SLA credit — logs show a 22m failover-related latency spike on 03/12 that breached their latency SLA for one window. SLA policy for this tier is 5% monthly credit on committed spend for each qualifying incident, capped at 25%. Provisional SLA credit calc: 5% of monthly committed bill ($12,000) = $600.

samir_ops: So proposed corrections:
- Correct duplicate reserved charge: -$4,800
- Apply SLA credit for incident: -$600
- Offer goodwill concession for the customer experience: -$150 (optional)

janet_am: So total provisional credit = $5,550. Customer asked for strike-through invoice and an adjusted total. That seems reasonable.

mike_fin: I approve a provisional credit up to $5,600 to expedite customer response. Please document the root cause and open a tracking ticket for allocation fix + backfill. Also include a note that this is a one-time correction; we shouldn't auto-change historical invoices without signoff.

emily_h: Thanks @mike_fin. I'll tell ClearWave we'll issue a corrected invoice and a $5,550 credit; we'll mark it provisional pending infra backfill ticket. Janet — can you confirm the wording before I send?

janet_am: Draft reply to customer: "Thanks for flagging — we found that a tag propagation issue caused duplicate reserved allocation for a short window. We've applied a $5,550 provisional credit and will send a corrected invoice once we've backfilled meter records. This is a one-time correction and will not change your committed profile going forward. ETA for corrected invoice: 48 business hours." Good?

emily_h: That works. Send it.

anna_infra: I will open infra ticket INFRA-54321 to fix the tag propagation bug and run a backfill for March 12-13. Action items on our side:
- Patch kv-tag-propagator to avoid duplicate tag sets on retry (root cause).
- Run backfill job to regenerate allocation lines for CW-112 for 2026-03 period.
- Produce S3 staging of corrected meter + updated invoice draft.

anna_infra: ETA for backfill and corrected invoice: 36 hours. I'll post updates in this thread and attach the infra ticket when created.

billing-bot: Metering alert posted: `duplicate-allocation-detected` CW-112 2026-03-12T02:00Z. Auto-detect flagged 1 duplicate allocation line.

emily_h: Logged: finance ticket FIN-7890 to apply provisional credit of $5,550 (pending backfill confirmation). Please link INFRA-54321 when available and route final approval to @mike_fin for the post-backfill invoice.

mike_fin: Approved. Once infra confirms backfill, billing ops can finalize the credit and send corrected invoice. Please include a short RCA paragraph in the customer note.

janet_am: Sending customer message now. I'll BCC legal for the corrected invoice template.

emily_h: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist for closure: 1) INFRA-54321 created + PR to fix propagator; 2) Backfill job completes and produces corrected allocation lines; 3) Finance applies credit and issues revised invoice; 4) Customer confirm receipt. I'll mark FIN-7890 status=waiting for INFRA-54321.

anna_infra: INFRA-54321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-54321 — I'll update here when backfill runs.

samir_ops: After backfill we should add a nightly validation that looks for duplicate allocation lines across tags for the same pool+window. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add that detection rule.

emily_h: Great. Closing the loop on our side after final invoice. :white_check_mark:
